verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS voice-agent platform like telli, but nothing in the evidence describes a self-hosted, on-prem, or downloadable deployment of the core product. Bring-your-own SIP trunk, call forwarding, the REST API, webhooks and the hosted MCP server all connect to telli's hosted service; they are adjacent integrations, not self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
